method: Reviewed each completed result's hypothesis, narrative, document context, source citations and uncertainty against the original synthetic fixture and cited spans. Separately compared route step kinds, order, roles, approval requirements and evidence requirements with maintained registry definitions. No additional model API calls were used.
criteria: Preserve all distinct logged errors and exact relevant identifiers, including leading zeroes.
Keep source and target contexts, attempts, chronology and processing outcomes distinct.
Use citations whose source meaning supports the attached factual statement.
Separate tentative causes and competing explanations from observed log facts and verified SAP state.
Do not claim that proposed corrections, approvals, checks, reprocessing or successful posting occurred.
Preserve maintained category-specific routing and human approval/evidence controls.
limitations: These are semantic review verdicts for the specific saved outputs, not a general accuracy guarantee or a production readiness certification.
The 13 unique fixtures are synthetic, short, English-language logs; ten focus on explicit master-data or mapping failures.
No independent SAP-domain human reviewer, real customer log evaluation, adversarial evaluation or production load test was performed.
A confidence label is not a calibrated probability; tentative wording and explicit uncertainty remain necessary.
Structural and citation integrity checks alone do not establish semantic correctness. Latency and cost evidence is recorded separately.

decision_evidence.compact_full: All 13 completed outputs pass this fixture-specific semantic review and automated gates. No material factual or uncertainty regression was found.
decision_evidence.compact_smoke: Both completed outputs pass this fixture-specific semantic review and automated gates.
decision_evidence.fast_full: Twelve published outputs pass semantic review; one file failed extraction twice and produced no published result. The faster profile therefore did not meet the full-suite completion gate.
